_doc: Research bandit (2026-10-02). Units: expected PUBLIC Global-WP gain over the current best single model, x1e-4. mu/sd = prior/posterior belief for the arm's best achievable gain; cost_h = GPU hours to the next decision point (2-fold screen unless noted); horizon_h = GPU hours left to the deadline. Update after every pull (ledger id in 'pulls'). noise_sd = sd of one pull's measurement (2-fold screen ~4; public pull ~5 incl. seed noise). 2026-10-02: same-arch screens may stop at epoch 2 (contrasts match ep3 within 0.0001-0.0004, OPT_REPORT F2) -> pulls ~25% cheaper.

target_stopped_bootstrap.evidence: unbiased by optional stopping; run-coherent noise 9x lower than alpha 0.7 (E-334); toy +0.0004

arch_lstm_student.status: pulled: pair ties GRU+GRU; cheaper partner for late bag
arch_lstm_student.evidence: plain LSTM -0.0013..-0.0035 vs GRU (E-081, E-168); distilled + bag-diversity untested

arch_tcn_student.evidence: never tested; L2-resident weights could make wider/extra members cheap; C128 L12: 0.87 MiB int16 (L2-resident), ~0.47x GRU256 MAC/row, RF 4096 rows; smoke 4.6 GB VRAM, ~1.45x LSTM192 step time

arch_two_timescale_state.status: closed tested configuration: both folds negative, pooled -0.001076
arch_two_timescale_state.evidence: half the loss in class-3 long quiet runs (E-323); dual-clock rejected but confounded (freeze bug per audit); twoclock: row GRU192x2 + event GRU128 stepping only on a6 endpoint rows (17.5% of rows), 1.56 MB int16, <= GRU256 MACs/row; E-357 confirms fold1 -0.000195, pooledCI [-.002658,.000152]

data_all_valid.status: needs a public pull (no local holdout left)
data_all_valid.evidence: teammate: valid weight 1x vs 0x +0.0011; holdout = 20% of valid unused by finals; lit-scout scaling law E-152 +0.0034/doubling -> ~+0.00015 for 368 seqs; E-350 student slope +0.0015/doubling

seed_bag_engine.evidence: holdout pair +0.0005 over singles; runtime 439 kcyc vs gate 423; lit-scout: DeltaGRU column skipping -29% MAC at fidelity 1.000000 (bit-exact on quantized activations), low-rank layer-2 SVD r=128 fidelity 0.99968 -20% MAC

input_representation.evidence: DTW, i1 lead-lag, analogs, retrieval all null

distill_rb_weight.evidence: Rao-Blackwellised KD weight: E[|y| x] head instead of realised |y|; same minimiser, lower variance, uses y=0 rows (Menon 2021); stacks with stopped bootstrap

distill_patient.evidence: Beyer 2022 patient/consistent KD: 8 epochs, teacher relabels the student's exact augmented view

muon_rnn.status: combo two matchedseeds positive; fold0dominates; frozenfold23 confirmationqueued
muon_rnn.evidence: Muon per gate block on W_hh/W_ih + AdamW rest; smoke ties AdamW (+0.0006+-0.0015) (OPT_REPORT.txt); E-356 combo seed3 minusMuon +.000562 CIcrosseszero; not additive; E-359: comboS4+.001788, bag+.001854 versus matchedcontrols; class3fold1negative

lstm_fbias_pair.evidence: LSTM forget bias / chrono tmax 8; GRU256+LSTM192 ~404 kcyc is the only 2-member bag under the gate (OPT_REPORT.txt)

student_chunk1000.evidence: TBPTT 1000 for the student (more updates, shorter horizon) (OPT_REPORT.txt)

student_width320.status: GRU384 +0.0020 on fold 0 (E-350); W320 deployable test queued
student_width320.evidence: wider distilled student; width helps only when distillation denoises labels; runtime-limited (OPT_REPORT.txt)

student_wsd6_ema.evidence: WSD schedule, 6 epochs + EMA: OneCycle 4th epoch = 25% time, 2.8% lr integral (OPT_REPORT.txt)

continuation_evidence.policy: Do not sum correlated combo/Muon/chunk/bootstrap effects or promote weak-ridge improvements. Numeric public priors unchanged until strong-control evidence.

round2_and_decoder_hybrid.decision: retain distinct mechanisms; no numerical public-gain posterior update from diagnostic proxies

round3_frozen.decision: capture actual coupled updates, require full suffix equality, treat physical coordinate as unidentified; no public-gain posterior update

round4_frozen.decision: capture source review before GPU parity; retention supported but deficit untested; teacher recorded exclusion supports shared lineage

fold23_confirmation.limits: Previously explored folds, combined recipe, fixed epoch3. No untouched-data, isolated-mechanism, or public-score claim.

round5_frozen.decision: confirmation accepted, peer proxy stays rejected; no new scientific CUDA arm
